content: ffmpeg SSIM/PSNR filters (lavfi): ssim=log.log and psnr=log.log write one line per frame with per-plane (Y/U/V) and aggregate values; PSNR log additionally has MSE alongside PSNR per plane. Both require identical resolution/pixel format and equal frame counts between the two inputs (no automatic alignment) — a precondition mediadiff's hash/dist semantics already anticipate.
